Under the hood

Technology we use

Explore the tools behind BANDEVI’s own website and enquiry workspace.

Front end

  • HTML

    HTML

    Structures pages and forms so content is easier to navigate.

  • CSS

    CSS

    Adapts layouts to mobile, tablet and desktop screens.

  • JS

    JavaScript

    Powers interactive demos, previews and guided forms.

  • SVG

    SVG

    Keeps interface icons sharp at different screen sizes.

Back end

  • PY

    Python

    Validates requests and runs enquiry and reporting workflows.

  • DB

    SQLite

    Stores enquiries, bookings and sales activity.

  • API

    HTTP APIs

    Connect forms and dashboards to the data they need.

  • NX

    Nginx

    Serves the public website and routes requests to the enquiry service.
